source_window.dataset_title: Search for land and property information

field_evidence.sign_in_requirement: The official service page states that users need to sign in to use the service and can create sign-in details if needed.
field_evidence.target_search: The service searches for property information.
field_evidence.title_plan_access: Title plan downloads are available through the service for a fee.
field_evidence.title_register_access: Title register downloads are available through the service for a fee.
field_evidence.no_login_constraint: The public landing page can be read anonymously, but target-specific document retrieval is outside the no-login window.

first_missing_criterion: Verified BUILDING_PRESENT canonical parcel geometry/bbox for this producer. HM Land Registry's official Search for land and property information service page is public/no-login to read, but explicitly requires sign-in to use the search service and charges for title-plan/register downloads. Under this producer's public/no-login source constraint, no target-specific title/register/plan document or parcel geometry can be retrieved from that service. Local OpenCode or an authenticated user-side HMLR workflow must obtain and spatially bind the target-specific title context; after that, bind one exact official DEM/LIDAR tile or metadata-index record to the resulting bbox.
exact_blocker: The official HM Land Registry search-service landing page is directly readable without login and materially changes the method from generic retrieval guidance to access-control validation. It states that users must sign in to use the service; title register and title plan downloads are paid. Because this producer is restricted to official public no-login windows, target-specific title/register/plan content cannot be fetched here. No canonical parcel geometry/bbox is therefore asserted, and spatial retrieval/join/materialization remains local OpenCode work.
